Title: General Availability: Azure Defender for Microsoft Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Defender for Cloud is now available for Microsoft Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server.  Defender for Cloud detects anomalous activities indicating unusual and potentially harmful attempts to access or exploit databases. When deployed, it provides additional important security barrier to your Azure Database for PostgreSQL server beyond the built-in security features.

Learn more.
